channel.title: TabSnap — Fair Restaurant Bill Splitter with Tip & Tax
channel.description: Smart, private itemized restaurant bill calculator. Split dishes, calculate proportional tips & sales tax, and copy an itemized breakdown ready for Venmo, iMessage, and WhatsApp.

item.title: TabSnap 1.0 Launch — Itemized Bill Splitting & Proportional Tipping
item.description: Official release of TabSnap: an instant, private, and client-side restaurant bill splitter. Allocate individual dishes and shared appetizers, compute mathematically fair proportional tips and sales tax, and generate one-click summaries for Venmo, iMessage, and WhatsApp without logging in.

item.title: Why Proportional Tipping is Fairer Than Splitting the Check Evenly
item.description: When group dinners split a check 50/50, diners who ordered simple dishes subsidize expensive entrees, craft cocktails, and desserts. TabSnap calculates tip and sales tax as an exact proportional percentage of each diner's individual subtotal, ensuring 100% mathematical fairness for everyone at the table.

item.title: Seamless Shared Dishes: Split Appetizers Across Any Table Subset
item.description: Tired of doing mental math for shared spinach dip or a bottle of wine between 3 friends at an 8-person table? TabSnap allows multi-select diner allocation per item, automatically dividing fractional costs and applying proportional tax and tip to only those participants.

item.title: Instant Export for Venmo, Zelle, Cash App & Group Chats
item.description: Generate beautifully formatted text summaries with diner totals, itemized item breakdowns, and optional Venmo, Zelle, or Cash App handles. Copy to your clipboard in one tap or share directly via mobile messages and WhatsApp.

item.title: 100% Private & Offline Ready: Zero Accounts, Zero Tracking
item.description: TabSnap runs 100% inside your browser using LocalStorage and modern Service Worker caching. Your receipts and dining details are never sent to external servers, and the calculator works reliably even in dining spots with spotty cell reception.
